## Key Risks

- Geopolitical restrictions on AI chip exports to China could reduce TAM by 20-30%
- Customer concentration risk: hyperscalers represent >40% of revenue
- Competitive threat from custom silicon (Google TPU, AWS Trainium)
- Valuation premium leaves little margin for execution missteps

## Growth Opportunities

- Sovereign AI infrastructure buildout across G20 nations
- Strong operational execution in new product ramps
- Expanding software and services attach rate via CUDA ecosystem
